column3: “Idols” interprets stumbling blocks; “worshipers” is supplied to the wicked.
“Every” is supplied before the remnant; the second group is simply “priests” without a second pagan designation.
“Punish” expresses the sense of visiting judgment.
“Punish” expresses the sense of visiting judgment.
“Your” is supplied before merchants; “weigh out” interprets carrying silver.
“Settled in complacency” replaces the image of congealing on their lees.
“Listen” is supplied; “the mighty” renders a singular warrior.
